mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance_plans (tenant_id, site_id, equipment_id, name, plan_type, content, cycle_days, next_due_date, assignee_user_id, enabled, created_by) VALUES (#{plan.tenantId}, #{plan.siteId}, #{plan.equipmentId}, #{plan.name}, #{plan.planType,javaType=com.equipops.domain.enums.MaintenancePlanType,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{plan.content}, #{plan.cycleDays}, #{plan.nextDueDate}, #{plan.assigneeUserId}, #{plan.enabled}, #{plan.createdBy})
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.site_id, p.equipment_id, p.name, p.plan_type, p.content, p.cycle_days, p.next_due_date, p.assignee_user_id, p.enabled, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, e.asset_code AS equipment_asset_code, e.name AS equipment_name, u.display_name AS assignee_name FROM maintenance_plans p LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND e.id = p.equipment_id LEFT JOIN tenant_memberships tm ON tm.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND tm.user_id = p.assignee_user_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = tm.user_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.id = #{id}
mapper.select: ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance_executions (tenant_id, plan_id, site_id, equipment_id, request_id, plan_name, plan_type, plan_content, cycle_days, scheduled_date, executed_at, executed_by, result, next_due_date, equipment_asset_code, equipment_name, executed_by_name) SELECT p.tenant_id, p.id, p.site_id, p.equipment_id, #{execution.requestId}, p.name, p.plan_type, p.content, p.cycle_days, p.next_due_date, #{execution.executedAt}, #{execution.executedBy}, #{execution.result}, #{execution.nextDueDate}, e.asset_code, e.name, u.display_name FROM maintenance_plans p INNER JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND e.id = p.equipment_id INNER JOIN tenant_memberships tm ON tm.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND tm.user_id = #{execution.executedBy} INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tm.user_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{execution.tenantId} AND p.id = #{execution.planId} AND p.enabled = TRUE AND p.assignee_user_id = tm.user_id AND p.next_due_date = #{execution.scheduledDate} AND tm.enabled = TRUE AND u.enabled = TRUE
